_comment: The theme tokens: every value a custom theme may change. web/src/lib/styles/tokens.css declares each one (tokens.spec.ts checks), web/src/lib/theme/tokens.ts reads this file, and server/internal/accounts/themetokens.go keeps the same names, types, schemes, ranks and bounds (TestThemeTokensMatchRegistry). A default ref names the token tokens.css sets it from; refs only point to a lower rank. Numbers carry their bounds. renamed maps an old name to its new one, for themes saved before a rename.
